description: Full Web IDE / Playground upgrade - Multi-panel IDE with syntax highlighting, autocomplete, debugger visualization, AST viewer, file explorer, and dark/light themes. Must work as a single HTML file or via npm run playground.
steps: Completely rewrite playground/index.html as a comprehensive single-file Web IDE (all HTML/CSS/JS in one file for easy deployment). The IDE should be substantial (3000+ lines) with real functionality.

Editor panel: Use a custom code editor with line numbers, syntax highlighting for TinyLang keywords/strings/numbers/comments, auto-indent, bracket matching, current line highlight, and basic autocomplete popup for TinyLang builtins/keywords triggered by typing.
Output panel: Console output with colored text support (errors in red, output in white/green). Clear button. Show execution time.

Debugger panel: Visual debugger with breakpoint gutter (click line numbers to toggle), step controls (Step Over, Step Into, Step Out, Continue), variable inspector showing current scope variables, call stack display, watch expressions input.
AST Viewer panel: Collapsible tree view of the parsed AST. Each node shows its type and key properties. Click a node to highlight corresponding source code.
File Explorer panel: Virtual filesystem sidebar. Create/rename/delete files. Multi-file project support with tabs in the editor. Save projects to localStorage.
Toolbar: Run button, Debug button, Format button, Theme toggle (dark/light), Share button (encode project in URL), Download project button, Settings (font size, tab size).

Include the full TinyLang engine (lexer, parser, interpreter, formatter, linter, compiler, VM) bundled inline in the HTML. Create a build script in playground/ that bundles src/ into a single JS blob for embedding.
Add example projects: each example from examples/ folder, plus additional multi-file demo projects.
Mobile responsive layout: stack panels vertically on small screens. Touch-friendly controls.
Performance profiler view: Show execution time per line (using interpreter hooks to track time spent).
Create playground/build.ts or playground/bundle.js script that compiles the TypeScript source into a single JS file and embeds it into the HTML template. Add npm script: playground:build.
Ensure the playground works by simply opening the built index.html file in a browser with no server required.
acceptance_criteria: The playground/index.html file opens in a browser and runs TinyLang code
Syntax highlighting correctly colors keywords, strings, numbers, comments
Autocomplete shows TinyLang builtins when typing
Debugger can set breakpoints and step through code visually
AST viewer shows the tree structure of parsed code
File explorer allows creating and switching between multiple files
Share button generates a URL that restores the project
Mobile layout is usable on small screens
findings: Implemented three language features: pipe operator (|>), enum types, and optional chaining (?.) with nullish coalescing (??). All features work in the interpreter (tree-walk only, not bytecode VM). 36 new tests added. Total tests: 435 passing. Build clean.
